post.description: Public webhook endpoint authenticated via the Apikey header (Authorization: Apikey <key> or Apikey header). Enforces idempotency via sepay_tx_id, atomically marks the matching pending payment transaction SUCCEEDED, and publishes PaymentSucceededEvent.

400.description: Bad request: malformed JSON payload or missing required webhook fields (id, transferType, transferAmount)

post.summary: Confirm receipt of a delivered order
post.description: Allows the owning authenticated CUSTOMER to confirm receipt of a DELIVERED order, atomically transitioning the order status from DELIVERED to COMPLETED while preserving carrier delivery timestamps.

400.description: Bad Request: invalid or non-positive order id path parameter

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

404.description: Not Found: order does not exist or belongs to another customer

409.description: Conflict: order is not in DELIVERED status or was concurrently modified

value.message: Cannot confirm delivery for order with status SHIPPING. Only DELIVERED orders can be confirmed.

post.summary: Checkout selected cart items to create an order
post.description: Creates a PENDING_PAYMENT order from selected cart items, deducts physical LED hardware stock atomically, snapshots order items and delivery information (when physical goods are present), initializes SEPAY payment intent, and removes only the checked-out cart items.

201.description: Order created successfully and awaiting payment confirmation

400.description: Bad Request: validation failure, invalid cart item, missing delivery address for physical goods, unavailable product, already owned digital product, or insufficient LED stock

value.message: One or more selected cart items do not exist or do not belong to your cart.
Delivery address or shipping details are required for physical orders.
Insufficient LED hardware stock for one or more selected items.
Customer already owns one or more selected digital products.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

404.description: Not Found: deliveryAddressId does not exist or belongs to another customer

post.description: Dispatches an eligible PROCESSING or PARTIALLY_FULFILLED physical order to AhaMove, saves tracking metadata on order_delivery (ASSIGNED), and transitions order status to SHIPPING.

400.description: Bad Request: invalid path id, malformed JSON, invalid dispatch fields, or AhaMove 400 validation error

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: caller is not an active internal STAFF, MANAGER, or ADMIN account

404.description: Not Found: order does not exist or AhaMove service was not found

406.description: Not Acceptable: rejected by AhaMove business rules (e.g., NOT_ENOUGH_CREDIT, INVALID_DELIVERY_AREA, INVALID_SERVICE_HOUR)

409.description: Conflict: order status/delivery is not eligible for dispatch or duplicate tracking conflict

503.description: Service Unavailable: AhaMove partner credentials/config missing or AhaMove service unavailable

get.description: Admin/manager only. Combines role, active status and email/name search filters. Excludes customer accounts and CUSTOMER roles in the database query before pagination. Results use stable accountId descending order.

post.description: Current active ADMIN only. Creates an ACTIVE EMPLOYEE with one STAFF, MANAGER or DESIGNER role. Generates a random password; only its BCrypt hash is stored. Credentials email is sent asynchronously after commit with bounded retries. Email failure does not roll back the created account. Creation audit is logged after commit. Password is never returned.

201.description: Internal account created; credentials email dispatched after commit

400.description: Invalid email, name, role or JSON

example.message: Invalid email, name, role or JSON

401.description: Authentication required or caller account missing

example.message: Authentication required or caller account missing

post.description: Public webhook endpoint authenticated via configurable AhaMove webhook token (API-Key header or Authorization Bearer token). Atomically, idempotently, and monotonically synchronizes AhaMove order lifecycle updates into order_delivery.delivery_status and orders.status.

200.description: Webhook accepted (processed, ignored as idempotent/terminal, or unmatched tracking number)

400.description: Bad Request: malformed JSON payload or missing required webhook fields (_id, status)

post.summary: Add item to active shopping cart
post.description: Adds a published product to the authenticated customer's active cart, initializing the cart if absent, enforcing digital item limits/ownership, and accumulating LED/bundle quantities within available stock.

200.description: Item added and updated shopping cart returned successfully

400.description: Bad Request: validation failure, unavailable product, already owned digital product, digital quantity limit exceeded, or insufficient stock

value.message: Product is not published for purchase.
Customer already owns this digital product.
Digital products cannot exceed a quantity of 1 in the cart.
Requested LED quantity exceeds available stock.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP code sent to customer's email during registration. Upon successful validation, transitions customer account status from PENDING_VERIFICATION to ACTIVE.

200.description: Email verified successfully; account is now ACTIVE

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains invalid fields, invalid/expired OTP, or account already verified

404.description: User account not found for provided email

429.description: Too many failed OTP attempts: maximum retry threshold exceeded

value.message: Maximum OTP attempts reached. Please request a new code.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.description: Public endpoint. Validates 6-digit OTP code against Redis, updates and hashes the new password, revokes all existing sessions/refresh tokens across all devices, and logs an audit event if internal staff.

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains missing/invalid fields, weak password, or invalid/expired OTP

details.message: Password must be 8-72 characters long, contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character, with no whitespace

404.description: User account not found with the provided email address

429.description: Maximum OTP verification attempts reached: token invalidated

example.message: Maximum OTP attempts reached. Please request a new code.

post.description: Re-generates and emails a new 6-digit verification OTP to a customer in PENDING_VERIFICATION status. Enforces a 60-second cooldown and a maximum of 3 resends per 24 hours.

202.description: Verification email request accepted for delivery

400.description: Validation failed: invalid request payload or account already verified

404.description: User account not found for provided email

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: cooldown period active (60s) or maximum resend quota reached (3 attempts)

value.message: Please wait 60 seconds before requesting another email.
Maximum resend attempts reached for this email.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.description: Registers a new customer account using email and password. Upon successful registration, the account is created in PENDING_VERIFICATION status and a verification OTP is dispatched to the user's email address.

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains invalid fields or passwords do not match

409.description: Conflict: The email address is already registered

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.summary: Refresh access and refresh JWT tokens
post.description: Validates the provided refresh token against active stored sessions (Redis or DB fallback), revokes the single-use token immediately (Token Rotation), and issues a new access and refresh token pair.

200.description: Tokens renewed successfully with new access and refresh token pair

400.description: Validation failed: refresh token is missing or blank

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid, expired, unrecognized, or already consumed refresh token, or account suspended/deleted

value.message: Refresh token is unrecognized or already consumed.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during token refresh

post.summary: Log out user session and invalidate tokens
post.description: Logs out the authenticated user by invalidating the provided refresh token, revoking all refresh tokens associated with the account across devices, and blacklisting the JWT access token in Redis until its natural expiration.

204.description: Session successfully terminated and tokens invalidated. No content returned.

400.description: Validation failed: Malformed request body or missing refresh token

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during logout

post.description: Authenticates user credentials using email and password. Upon success, returns access and refresh tokens. Failed attempts are tracked (lockout occurs after 5 failed attempts).

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains missing or invalid fields

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid email or password

423.description: Locked: Account is locked for 15 minutes due to consecutive failed attempts

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.summary: Authenticate or register via Google OAuth2
post.description: Authenticates a customer using a Google ID token. If the user account does not exist, an account and customer profile are automatically created with ACTIVE status and email verified. Returns access and refresh JWT tokens.

200.description: User authenticated successfully via Google OAuth2

400.description: Validation failed: Google ID token is missing or invalid

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid or expired Google ID token, or Google login rejected for staff/inactive accounts

value.message: Google login is not supported for staff accounts.

423.description: Locked: Account is temporarily locked due to consecutive failed attempts

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during Google authentication

post.description: Public endpoint. Sends a six-digit code valid for five minutes if the email exists. The first three requests in 24 hours are allowed; the fourth locks requests for 24 hours. Unknown email returns the same acknowledgement and has the same request limits.

400.description: Invalid email

example.message: Password reset requests are locked for 24 hours.
